info.name: Hospigo 4a OPD visit and billing
info.description: Step 4a. Select the Hospigo Local environment (superadminPassword and staffPassword). Seed first: npm run prisma:migrate -w @hospigo/api and npm run prisma:seed -w @hospigo/api (the demo roles need the new permissions). Requests 7b to 7d check the price preview and the expected-total safety check. Requests 11b to 11d need the hospital setting repeat_visit_free_hours above 0 (the demo seed sets 24)., then start the API on port 3000 and Run collection. About 9 calls count against the login/refresh IP limit (20 per minute): wait a minute between runs.
